thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: API-GW high 5xx rate (502/504). Incident created: GW-502504-3367. Paging tanvi_oncall and mike_sre. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC3367

 tanvi_oncall: seeing ~15% 502s at edge in eu-west and ~8% in us-east. spikes starting ~02:00 UTC. pages going off.

 mike_sre: started tcpdump on a failing proxy pod, capturing logs to s3: s3://redwood-incidents/GW-3367/pcap.tar.gz. putting trace link in thread.

 tanvi_oncall: thx. can we enable mux circuit-breaker to limit fanout? high 502 fanout looks like cascade.

 engineer_jamie: quick check: model-router pods report Ready=3/3 but pod CPU at 90% and 95th latency 2.1s for /infer. upstream timeouts look likely.

 sara_prod: any recent edge deploys? support seeing customer errors.

 deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-17T01:45:00 id=r-edge-proxy-v5 at 30% (progressing).

 mike_sre: rolling back v5 will take ~3m to cut traffic. prepping rollback command:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/edge-proxy --to-revision=4
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/edge-proxy --replicas=6
```

 tanvi_oncall: if rollback too risky, try routing fallback to standby region for affected prefixes. start with /api/v1/generate.

 mike_sre: running circuit-breaker config patch now to limit concurrent upstream conns (applied to mux-ingress). patch diff: `max_conns: 200 -> 50`

 support-bot: 120 customer errors reported in last 5m, two customers flagged high severity (acct-993, acct-1204). Posting to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/GW-3367

 sara_prod: can we throttle heavy clients? maybe a misbehaving client causing head-of-line.

 mike_sre: quick ip-snapshot from proxy logs shows heavy retry patterns from 18.199.23.45 and 34.78.11.9. Blocking temporarily at edge for 2m for testing.

 engineer_jamie: model-router shows increased 504s to backend infra-db; DB connection pool maxed. opening DB pool autoscale ticket.

 tanvi_oncall: mitigation summary: 1) applied CB to mux, 2) blocked aggressive client IPs, 3) started rollback window for edge-proxy v5 if no improvement in 5m.

 mike_sre: metrics: 502 rate dropped from 15% -> 6% in eu-west after CB + blocks. latency still elevated.

 deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 30% (manual pause requested).

 tanvi_oncall: good. will call for customer comms. @support-bot please draft status update: short summary + ETA (investigating, partial mitigation in place).

 support-bot: Draft: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for API traffic in EU and US regions. Mitigations applied; some traffic rerouted. We will update within 30 minutes." Posting now. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

 tanvi_oncall: preparing handoff to night oncall @alex_oncall in 30m. alex, will handover runbook + current links: traces, pcap, status.

 alex_oncall: ack, I'll take over at 02:30 UTC. will monitor 502/504 rates and customer tickets. please @mention if rollback runs.

 tanvi_oncall: leaving note: next steps if 502s persist: 1) rollback edge-proxy to v4, 2) scale model-router DB pool, 3) route prefix to standby region.

 mike_sre: adding postmortem stub, will capture timeline and mitigation actions.

 tanvi_oncall: thanks team. closing active page once error rate <1% and status page updated. :thumbsup:

 alex_oncall: taking watch. ping me for any regressions.
